Krownlandia Community Bulletin

November 25, 2026 · A snapshot of recent park changes.

Inspired by “Post News #KrownlandiaNews,” credited to @lisachandler on page 16 of the original places list. This bulletin is a new interpretation for the park prototype. It is read-only and contains no event announcements.

Explore without 3D

Choose Reading Shelf from the gateway to find craft guides, arts activities, and puzzles. Try splitting imaginary pizza slices, arranging a radio schedule, or recommending an activity for the square. Every reading links back to the shelf.

Walk with text directions

Choose a destination, then open Park menu → Explore → Text-only directions. The distance and next turn stay in view while the gold trail is hidden. Select the same setting to restore the trail.

From the November 22 bulletin

Try the village crafts

Open Community Walk and select Village Craft Trail for directions to Meadowbrook weaving, Riverbend pottery and baskets, Eldergrove woodcraft, Stonehearth stone patterns, and Whispering Pines pinewood inlay.

Read the printable Village Craft Guide for activities you can do without 3D.

Find the Sewing Club sampler

Search the park map for “Sewing Club” and follow directions to the Clubhouse board. Open the optional sampler to follow a six-stitch pattern. The practice design resets when you reopen the board.

Keep a copy of saved progress

If 3D cannot start but JavaScript is available, the gateway’s reading screen offers “Save a copy of your progress.” The export reads park progress stored in this browser and uses the existing backup format. Restore from the normal backup controls inside the park.
